verdict.rationale: ADK's docs say it works with almost any generative AI model. They describe adapters for Gemini, other leading providers and locally running models, and list 'swap the underlying intelligence of your agents' as an explicit capability. The agent definition takes the model as a single parameter, so swapping it does not require rewriting the agent. Missing for 10: named adapters or providers with a worked provider-swap example, caveats on feature parity across non-Gemini models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
